skill.summary: Provide your financial details to get a personalized wealth plan with best savings rates, hidden fee detection, optimized debt payoff, investing roadmap, and...

latestVersion.changelog:
v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Finds best savings rates, investment platforms, and credit card offers in real-time for maximum returns and lowest fees.
- Scans for hidden subscription costs, unnecessary fees, and potential savings based on your financial data.
- Generates a complete, personalized wealth plan: debt payoff strategy, emergency fund guidance, investing roadmap, and 10-year wealth projection.
- Produces a shareable personal finance summary video via InVideo AI.
- Integrates Apify for real-time financial product scraping and Claude AI for customized planning.
